_origem: codigo anterior ao SEG-04: _internal_get('/gyms') e _internal_get('/exercise-mapping-catalog?limit=500&active_only=true') via HTTP com token mestre

statements.sql: SELECT * FROM gyms WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY name

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM exercise_catalog ec LEFT JOIN muscle_groups pg ON pg.id = ( SELECT emc_pri.muscle_group_id FROM exercise_muscle_contributions emc_pri WHERE emc_pri.exercise_id = ec.id AND emc_pri.role = 'PRIMARY' AND emc_pri.is_active = 1 ORDER BY emc_pri.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN muscle_groups sg ON sg.id = ( SELECT emc_sec.muscle_group_id FROM exercise_muscle_contributions emc_sec WHERE emc_sec.exercise_id = ec.id AND emc_sec.role = 'SECONDARY' AND emc_sec.is_active = 1 ORDER BY emc_sec.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE ec.is_active = 1

SELECT ec.id, ec.name AS exercise_name, ( SELECT exm.external_name FROM exercise_external_mappings exm WHERE exm.exercise_id = ec.id AND exm.provider = 'AMAZFIT' AND exm.is_active = 1 ORDER BY exm.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS amazfit_name, NULL AS equipment, ec.body_position, ec.movement, ec.trajectory, ec.biomechanical_pattern, ec.primary_joint, ec.resistance_vector, pg.id AS primary_group_id, pg.name AS primary_group, sg.id AS secondary_group_id, sg.name AS secondary_group, ec.keywords, ec.description, ( SELECT exm.mapping_status FROM exercise_external_mappings exm WHERE exm.exercise_id = ec.id AND exm.provider = 'AMAZFIT' AND exm.is_active = 1 ORDER BY exm.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS mapping_status, ( SELECT exm.source FROM exercise_external_mappings exm WHERE exm.exercise_id = ec.id AND exm.provider = 'AMAZFIT' AND exm.is_active = 1 ORDER BY exm.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS source, ec.is_active, ec.created_at, ec.updated_at FROM exercise_catalog ec LEFT JOIN muscle_groups pg ON pg.id = ( SELECT emc_pri.muscle_group_id FROM exercise_muscle_contributions emc_pri WHERE emc_pri.exercise_id = ec.id AND emc_pri.role = 'PRIMARY' AND emc_pri.is_active = 1 ORDER BY emc_pri.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN muscle_groups sg ON sg.id = ( SELECT emc_sec.muscle_group_id FROM exercise_muscle_contributions emc_sec WHERE emc_sec.exercise_id = ec.id AND emc_sec.role = 'SECONDARY' AND emc_sec.is_active = 1 ORDER BY emc_sec.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE ec.is_active = 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN ec.name = %s THEN 0 WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM exercise_aliases ea_exact WHERE ea_exact.exercise_id = ec.id AND ea_exact.alias = %s ) THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, pg.name, ec.name LIMIT %s OFFSET %s
